description.raw: '''Innate:''' '''Fiora''' identifies the Vitals of nearby enemy champions, marked as an arc around them in North-, East-, South- or Westward direction. Vitals take 1.75 seconds to become targetable and linger for 13.25 seconds afterwards while '''Fiora''' remains near the target, otherwise the Vital will disappear. After a Vital expires, '''Fiora''' identifies a new one on her target.

description2.raw: Dealing damage in the direction of a Vital will trigger it to deal [[File:Hybrid penetration icon.png|15px|link=True damage]] '''bonus''' true damage equal to 3% (+ 4% per 100 '''bonus''' AD) of target's '''maximum''' health, [[File:Heal power icon.svg|20px|link=Healing|An icon representing the keyword Heal]] [[:Healing|heal]] '''Fiora''' for 35 – 100 (based on level), and grant her 20% / 30% / 40% / 50% (based on [[File:Grand Challenge.png|20px|link=]] ''Grand Challenge's'' Rank) [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] '''bonus''' movement speed that decays over 1.85 seconds.
description2.text: Dealing damage in the direction of a Vital will trigger it to deal  bonus true damage equal to 3% (+ 4% per 100 bonus AD) of target's maximum health, heal Fiora for 35 – 100 (based on level), and grant her 20% / 30% / 40% / 50% (based on Grand Challenge's Rank)  bonus movement speed that decays over 1.85 seconds.

notes.raw: * Vitals can be triggered by any source of damage '''Fiora''' deals, except those with [[File:Minion Dematerializer rune.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Default damage]] [[:Damage|default damage]] and [[File:Thornmail item.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Reactive damage]] [[:Damage|reactive damage]] types. * The Vitals are visible to all units. * A Vital's angle is fixed to the champion's model and doesn't interact with its orientation. * Vitals spawn directions alternate in a Northeast-Southwest pattern. Other than that, they have a 50% chance to spawn North or East, or South or West, respectively. ** PENDING FOR TEST: The direction of the first Vital upon '''Fiora''' and her enemy encountering one another in the game for the first time is always Southward or Westward. This is true regardless of whether Fiora is in the Blue or Red team. * Vitals will not trigger if the attack is [[File:Jax Counter Strike old.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Dodge]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|dodged]] or missed while '''Fiora''' is [[File:Blind icon.png|20px|link=Blind|An icon representing the keyword Blind]] [[:Blind|blinded]]. ** [[File:Spirit's Refuge.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Block]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|Block]] will not prevent a trigger. ** If the Vital is triggered by [[File:Fiora Lunge.png|20xpx|border|link=Fiora#Lunge|An icon for Fiora's ability Lunge]] [[Fiora#Lunge|Lunge]], it can be [[File:Jax Counter Strike old.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Dodge]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|dodged]], but it can't be [[File:Spirit's Refuge.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Block]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|blocked]] and will trigger even if '''Fiora''' is [[File:Blind icon.png|20px|link=Blind|An icon representing the keyword Blind]] [[:Blind|blinded]]. * Vitals are identified upon an enemy gaining [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of '''Fiora''', and they are maintained while enemies maintain [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of '''Fiora'''. ** If '''Fiora''' has no sight of the enemy (and is in the valid radius of her), the Vital will not disappear. ** If the enemy has no sight of '''Fiora''', Vitals are not identified.
notes.text:
Vitals can be triggered by any source of damage Fiora deals, except those with default damage and reactive damage types.
The Vitals are visible to all units.
A Vital's angle is fixed to the champion's model and doesn't interact with its orientation.
Vitals spawn directions alternate in a Northeast-Southwest pattern. Other than that, they have a 50% chance to spawn North or East, or South or West, respectively.
* PENDING FOR TEST: The direction of the first Vital upon Fiora and her enemy encountering one another in the game for the first time is always Southward or Westward. This is true regardless of whether Fiora is in the Blue or Red team.
Vitals will not trigger if the attack is dodged or missed while Fiora is blinded.
* Block will not prevent a trigger.
* If the Vital is triggered by Lunge, it can be dodged, but it can't be blocked and will trigger even if Fiora is blinded.
Vitals are identified upon an enemy gaining sight of Fiora, and they are maintained while enemies maintain sight of Fiora.
* If Fiora has no sight of the enemy (and is in the valid radius of her), the Vital will not disappear.
* If the enemy has no sight of Fiora, Vitals are not identified.
